query: SELECT r.tenant_id, r.kind, r.key FROM tenants AS t JOIN idempotency_records AS r ON r.tenant_id = t.id WHERE t.state = 'deleted' AND t.content_removed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM namespaces AS n WHERE n.tenant_id = t.id AND n.content_removed_at IS NULL) LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE OF r SKIP LOCKED
